title: Overnight success takes years: Sam Parr's 2013 CEO Doc on apprenticeship and mastery
summary: A 2013 essay from Sam Parr's old blog arguing that "overnight success" is mostly a myth. Drawing on Robert Greene's Mastery, he says most monetary success takes decades of apprenticeship, and he built a spreadsheet (the CEO Doc) tracking how long famous founders worked before breaking out.

principles.text: "Overnight success" is mostly nonsense; most monetary success takes decades.
principles.quote: for the majority of people who’ve achieve monetary success, it took decades

principles.text: Behind nearly every success are years and years of hard work, not months from idea to IPO.
principles.quote: Behind (nearly) every success is years, and years of hard work.

principles.text: Mastery requires roughly 5 to 10 years of intense study, basically an apprenticeship.
principles.quote: To master your craft, you must study intensely for 5 to 10 years…so basically, an apprenticeship.

principles.text: Successful people are those who have mastered their craft.
principles.quote: Successful people, (and “geniuses”) are folks who have mastered their craft.
